thread:
maria: kicking off release-2026-03-23 for runtime-service v3.2.0. main change: model-route v4 + new kv-cache tuning. plan is a soft-fade flag rollout (attenuation handshake) rather than a hard flip. :eyes:

release-bot: /deploy release-2026-03-23 runtime-service v3.2.0 - started by maria

maria: high-level plan:
- set ff.runtime.new_route to `shadow` (0%) during deploy
- post-deploy: soft-fade old->new with attenuation steps: 5% -> 20% -> 50% -> 100% (each step 3m soak)
- safety gates: p95 latency delta <= 120ms, error rate delta <= 0.4% absolute
- rollback if any gate fails (fast drain to previous route + rollback tag v3.1.9)

tonny: @maria typo: tony here — I'll own the metrics watch and manual rollback if needed. setting up dashboards now. :thumbsup:

samir: I'll pin the old model binary on nodes that still serve old route for 15m post-rollout so we can quick-swap. running pin script now:
```
# pin runtime version on shard-az1
ssh infra@ops-az1 "sudo runtimectl pin runtime-service v3.1.9"
```

jen: oncall checklist prepped. I'll keep paging rules open for the first 30m after 50% step. If rate-of-errors > 0.6% for 2 consecutive mins I will initiate rollback.

maria: small comms detail: we'll call the pattern "soft-fade/attenuation handshake" in the release notes so support understands non-zero initial traffic to new route. avoids confusion with "canary" naming.

release-bot: step 1 completed: deploy containers healthy. healthchecks: all green.

maria: enabling ff.runtime.new_route at 5% now. command: `flags set ff.runtime.new_route 5 --release=release-2026-03-23`

tony: ack, watching p95 and error-rate graphs (prod-telemetry). p50 stable. p95 +22ms so far. no errors. :eyes:

samir: started KV cache warmup on new route, logs look sane. tail:
```
[2026-03-23T04:12:03Z] warmup: kv-cache hit-rate rising -> 18%
[2026-03-23T04:12:10Z] kv-cache priming chunk 3/8 done
```

jen: first soak complete at 5% — no alerts, continue to 20% in 30s.

maria: moving to 20% now. `flags set ff.runtime.new_route 20`

tony: p95 +45ms, still under gate. error rate +0.05% absolute. holding. :thumbsup:

release-bot: flag update: ff.runtime.new_route -> 20% (propagated to all edge routers)

jen: note to self: if we see increased tail latency tied to kv-cache misses, we should consider a slower step or transient 10% hold.

maria: agreed. we'll give 3m per step but can extend. also adding a small log grep to correlate errors->route id:
```
kubectl logs -l service=runtime-service | grep "route=new-v4" | tail -n 50
```

tony: 3m in at 20% — p95 trending up but still within 90ms delta. I don't like the small spike at 04:18, marking it for follow-up but not blocking.

samir: infra note: autoscaler bump happened at 20% due to short-lived qps spike; scaling looks healthy, no OOMs.

maria: moving to 50% now. `flags set ff.runtime.new_route 50` — tagging release notes: "soft-fade: 5->20->50->100, safety gates p95+120ms / errors +0.4%"

release-bot: flag update: ff.runtime.new_route -> 50%

jen: enabling extended monitoring: paging windows extended to 45m after 50% step. If p95 crosses threshold for 4m straight I'll trigger rollback.

tonny: at 50% p95 is +130ms in one region (eu-west-1). creating a region filter -> looks isolated to eu-west edge. running `rollout diagnostic` now.

maria: decision point: since it's regional, we can do a regional attenuation rollback (drain new-route traffic in eu-west only) instead of full rollback. @samir can you pin eu-west old-route?

samir: on it. running regional flag set:
`flags set ff.runtime.new_route --region=eu-west-1 0`

release-bot: regional flag update: eu-west-1 ff.runtime.new_route -> 0%

tony: p95 in eu-west started to fall back after regional drain. global p95 back within gate. good call.

maria: we'll keep eu-west pinned to old route for the next 2 hours and continue the global fade to 100% elsewhere. note in release notes: "eu-west retained old routing due to transient tail latency; manual regional attenuation applied, no full rollback."

jen: filed incident note in pagerduty as a minor triage: INC-2026-334, status: contained, regional attenuation applied.

maria: continuing to 100% in non-eu-west. `flags set ff.runtime.new_route 100 --exclude-region=eu-west-1`

release-bot: flag update: ff.runtime.new_route -> 100% (excluded eu-west-1)

tony: global is at 100% (except eu-west). monitoring. p95 stable.

samir: I left the old binary pinned in eu-west for 2h as requested. command diff to undo pin later: `runtimectl unpin runtime-service`

maria: wrap-up notes for release doc (will paste into GH release):
- Change: runtime-service v3.2.0, model-route v4 + kv-cache tuning
- Rollout style: soft-fade / attenuation handshake steps (5->20->50->100) with 3m soaks
- Safety gates: p95 <= +120ms, error-rate <= +0.4% absolute
- Incident: transient eu-west p95 spike -> regional attenuation applied (eu-west stayed on v3.1.9 for 2h)
- Action items: infra to add region-specific warmup in next release, metrics team to add a heatmap alert for route-specific tail latency

jen: marking thread resolved in 2h after pinned unpin. cc @support for release note blurb. :white_check_mark:

maria: thanks team — excellent attenuation handshake. shipit. :shipit:
